device.category: single-voice patchable (semi-modular) analogue synthesizer with MIDI-to-CV, desktop, Eurorack signal levels
device.based_on: Original Make Noise design (manual REV 7, May 2016) mixing Moog ('East Coast') and Buchla ('West Coast') techniques without following either: 'no coast synthesis'. Retail $499. Current firmware 1.6.8.

sources.title: Make Noise 0-COAST manual, REV 7 (5.19.16)
sources.note: Normalisation diagram, numbered panel legend (1-61), default sounds, MIDI and program pages, MIDI CC list, every circuit with patching examples, open patch points, overriding normals, Voltage MATH, signal levels, patch ideas (drawn) and MIDI pin-out. Knob settings are given as clock positions.

sources.title: Sound On Sound, Make Noise 0-Coast review
sources.note: No filter; VCO tracks about four octaves; oscillator sync by triggering Slope from the square.

sources.title: ModWiggler, 'No Coast slope/contour subharmonics - why?'
sources.note: Forum explanation: the function generator ignores triggers during its rise but retriggers during its fall, which divides an audio-rate trigger into subharmonics.

architecture.synthesis_note: Hybrid East/West: one triangle-core VCO, additive harmonics from OVERTONE and MULTIPLY (wavefolding), a BALANCE crossfade and a low-pass gate (DYNAMICS); no conventional filter.
architecture.signal_path_note: 100 % analogue signal path; the MIDI circuit is digital.
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory. Program page settings are kept; holding PGM_A and PGM_B at power-on restores their defaults.
architecture.panel_counts_note: 29 = 13 patchable sources + 14 destinations (Make Noise's own figures, matching this file's ports) + MIDI IN + LINE OUT.
architecture.summary: MIDI A sets the oscillator pitch (always, summed with the 1V/OCT input) and gates CONTOUR. The VCO's triangle and square feed OVERTONE, which adds one harmonic (odd, then even, then blends in SLOPE at full clockwise); MULTIPLY folds that into more overtones, modulated by SLOPE through a normal. BALANCE crossfades the plain triangle (FUND) against the overtone path (OVRTN) into DYNAMICS, a low-pass gate opened by CONTOUR, then the line output. SLOPE is a 0-8 V rise/fall function, triggered or cycling up to audio rate. Voltage MATH, a clock with tap tempo, stepped random and MIDI B (CV and gate from note, velocity, mod wheel or LFOs) are free to patch.

modules.name: MIDI A / MIDI B (MIDI-to-CV)
modules.description: Two-channel MIDI-to-CV converter on a TRS minijack MIDI input (all channels by default). MIDI A CV is hardwired to the oscillator; MIDI A Gate is normalled to CONTOUR. MIDI B CV and Gate have jacks and selectable sources. Also hosts the arpeggiator (MIDI only) and clock-synced portamento.

properties.dac: calibrated to the internal VCO; MIDI B calibratable to an external VCO

modules.name: Clock
modules.description: Clock whose tempo comes from tapping PGM_B, pulses at TEMPO input and MIDI clock (if enabled), combined. Drives CLK OUT, stepped random, arpeggio and portamento timing.

modules.name: Stepped random
modules.description: A new random voltage (0 to +10 V) on each clock cycle.

modules.name: Voltage MATH
modules.description: CH1 (unity) plus CH2 (through an attenuverter; normalled to an offset) summed to two identical outputs: mixer, offset generator, inverter, attenuator and mult.

modules.name: Oscillator
modules.description: Triangle-core VCO with triangle and square outputs (about 10 Vpp). Pitch from coarse and fine knobs, MIDI A, the 1V/OCT input (tracks about 4 octaves) and AC-coupled linear FM.

modules.name: Overtone
modules.description: Uses the square to add a single harmonic to the triangle: odd harmonic counter-clockwise, a transitional state, even harmonic, and at full clockwise the SLOPE signal is blended into the audio path.

modules.name: Multiply
modules.description: Multiplies the single overtone into more overtones (a wave multiplier/folder): adds harmonics as it turns clockwise, the opposite of a low-pass filter.

modules.name: Slope
modules.description: Rise/fall function generator, 0 to +8 V, triggered once (no sustain) or self-cycling as an LFO up to audio rate. Vari-Response shapes the segments log, linear or expo. EOC is high except during the fall.

properties.retrigger: ignored during rise, accepted during fall (ModWiggler explanation)

modules.name: Contour
modules.description: Four-stage envelope, 0 to +8 V: ONSET (attack), DECAY (decay and release), SUSTAIN level, Vari-Response linear to expo. EON goes high at the end of onset until the decay finishes.

modules.name: Balance
modules.description: Crossfades FUND (normalled oscillator triangle, or the BALANCE input) against OVRTN (Multiply output). The combo pot sets the blend, or attenuates CV patched to BALANCE CV.

modules.name: Dynamics
modules.description: Low-pass gate: one control makes the sound both louder and brighter, like a Buchla 292 but with transistors instead of vactrols. CV from CONTOUR (normalled); the knob attenuates it.

modules.name: Line output
modules.description: Line-level stereo TRS output (3 Vpp) with LEVEL, clean to about 80 % then clipping (OVL lights). The DYNMC output gives the same signal at 10 Vpp.

parameters.label: PGM_A
parameters.function: Hold: enter program pages (and in a page, reset it to default). Press: next page. Tap twice or more (outside pages): MIDI B LFO rate.

parameters.label: PGM_B
parameters.function: Tap: clock tempo (and arpeggio rate). Hold: panic (stops MIDI and arp notes; clears Latch & Shift). In a page: step the value; hold to exit.

parameters.function: Traditional (held notes in played order) or Latch & Shift (notes added and kept after release; replay removes; up to 20, oldest dropped).

parameters.label: Page 2: Legato
parameters.function: On: MIDI A gate stays high until all notes are released (one Contour). Off: retrigger on every new note.

parameters.label: Page 3: MIDI A channel

parameters.function: Receive channel for MIDI A (learned).

parameters.label: Page 3: MIDI B channel

parameters.label: Page 7: Calibrate
parameters.function: Calibrates MIDI A to the VCO (about 3 min) or MIDI B to an external VCO via the TEMPO input (about 6 min). Warm up 20 minutes first.

parameters.label: PITCH
parameters.function: Coarse frequency (large grey knob).

parameters.label: FINE
parameters.function: Fine tune.

parameters.label: LIN FM attenuator
parameters.function: Depth (index) of linear FM from the LIN FM input; over about 80 % the FM bus overdrives and tracking suffers.

parameters.label: Calibration trimmer
parameters.function: Oscillator calibration trimmer.

parameters.label: OVERTONE
parameters.function: Odd harmonic (CCW) through a transitional state to even, then blends in SLOPE at full clockwise.

parameters.label: OVERTONE CV attenuator
parameters.function: Depth of CV at the OVERTONE input; zero at full CCW. Full CW gives 50 % modulation depth from the panel's centre.

parameters.label: MULTIPLY
parameters.function: Amount of added overtones.

parameters.label: MULTIPLY CV attenuverter

panel_scale.note: attenuverter; 12:00 = 0 (no effect), full CCW = full inversion

parameters.function: Depth and direction of CV at the MULTIPLY input (normally SLOPE).

parameters.label: CYCLE
parameters.function: Self-cycles SLOPE as an LFO or audio-rate oscillator (button lit white).

parameters.label: RISE
parameters.function: Time to reach +8 V; clockwise is slower.

parameters.label: FALL
parameters.function: Time back to 0 V; clockwise is slower.

parameters.label: Vari-Response
parameters.function: Segment shape from log through linear to expo; more expo is also faster.

parameters.label: ONSET
parameters.function: Attack time to +8 V.

parameters.label: SUSTAIN
parameters.function: Sustain level; full CCW gives an AD shape, full CW an ASR.

parameters.label: DECAY
parameters.function: Decay time to the sustain level, and release time after the gate ends.

parameters.label: Vari-Response
parameters.function: Segment shape from linear to expo; more expo is faster and more percussive.

parameters.label: BALANCE
parameters.function: FUND (CCW) to OVRTN (CW); with a cable in BALANCE CV it attenuates that CV instead.

parameters.label: DYNAMICS
parameters.function: Attenuates the CV opening the low-pass gate (normally CONTOUR); set to at least 3:00 for the default sound.

parameters.label: LEVEL
parameters.function: Line output volume; clean to about 80 %, then clips (OVL).

ports.label: Voltage MATH CH2

ports.label: Voltage MATH OUT 2
ports.function: Identical copy of OUT 1.

ports.label: Oscillator TRIANGLE
ports.function: Triangle, about 10 Vpp; patching it leaves the normal to BALANCE in place.

ports.label: Oscillator SQUARE
ports.function: Square, about 10 Vpp.

ports.label: 1V/OCT
ports.function: Pitch CV, summed with MIDI A; tracks reasonably over 4 octaves.

ports.label: LIN FM
ports.function: AC-coupled linear FM at the LIN FM attenuator's depth.

ports.function: Modulates OVERTONE through its attenuator.

ports.function: Modulates MULTIPLY through its attenuverter; normalled to SLOPE.

ports.function: Modulates rise and fall time equally.

ports.label: EOC
ports.function: End of cycle: high except while SLOPE falls.

ports.label: SLOPE TRIG
ports.function: Rising edge fires one rise/fall function.

ports.label: SLOPE OUT
ports.function: SLOPE function, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: CONTOUR DECAY
ports.function: Modulates decay time.

ports.label: CONTOUR GATE
ports.function: Gate for CONTOUR; normalled to MIDI A gate.

ports.label: EON
ports.function: End of onset: high from the end of onset until the decay finishes.

ports.function: CONTOUR function, 0 to +8 V.

ports.label: BALANCE CV
ports.function: CV for the blend; the combo pot becomes its attenuator.

ports.function: Stereo TRS line output, 3 Vpp, for headphones or a mixer (use TS into balanced inputs).

ports.label: DYNAMICS CV
ports.function: Opens the low-pass gate; normalled to CONTOUR.

ports.label: DYNMC OUT
ports.function: Modular-level output, 10 Vpp; not for line equipment or headphones.

ports.function: 15 V DC, tip positive; Make Noise adapter only.

behaviours.name: Normalled voice
behaviours.rule: With no cables: MIDI A pitch to the VCO, triangle and square into OVERTONE then MULTIPLY (modulated by SLOPE), BALANCE between triangle and overtones, DYNAMICS opened by CONTOUR, which MIDI A gates. Gold panel lines show the flow; arrows mark normals that a cable breaks.

behaviours.name: Patching rules
behaviours.rule: Every jack is an input or an output. Input to input does nothing; output to output is unpredictable but harmless. Patching an output never breaks its normals; patching an input does.

behaviours.name: Signal levels
behaviours.rule: Eurorack levels: audio about 10 Vpp, functions 0 to +8 V, gates +8 V, random 0 to +10 V, everything within ±10 V. Gate inputs respond to anything rising above about 2 V. Line out 3 Vpp; DYNMC out 10 Vpp.

behaviours.name: Overtone
behaviours.rule: Turning OVERTONE clockwise moves the added harmonic from odd through a transitional state to even; at full clockwise SLOPE is blended into the audio path (inharmonic, ring-mod-like unless SLOPE is tuned to the VCO).

behaviours.name: Multiply
behaviours.rule: Adds overtones above the one from OVERTONE as it turns clockwise; additive (West Coast), the reverse of sweeping a low-pass filter.

behaviours.name: Balance
behaviours.rule: FUND (CCW) is the plain triangle, almost a sub-octave to the overtone side; OVRTN (CW) is the processed signal. Sweeping it is like opening a low-pass filter. A cable in BALANCE CV turns the knob into that CV's attenuator.

behaviours.name: Low-pass gate
behaviours.rule: DYNAMICS raises level and brightness together, like a Buchla 292 but with transistors, so it responds faster than a vactrol gate. CONTOUR opens it through the DYNAMICS knob; patch an offset to DYNAMICS CV for a drone.

behaviours.name: Slope
behaviours.rule: Trigger: one 0 V to +8 V rise and fall, no sustain (only the rising edge counts). A forum explanation adds that triggers are ignored during the rise but accepted during the fall, so an audio-rate trigger divides into subharmonics. CYCLE: repeats as an LFO, fast enough for audio. RISE and FALL set times and shape (fast rise, slow fall gives a saw). Vari-Response bends segments log, linear or expo, and expo also speeds it up. TIME CV scales both.

behaviours.name: Contour
behaviours.rule: Onset to +8 V, decay to SUSTAIN while the gate is high, then back to 0 V at the DECAY rate. SUSTAIN at minimum gives AD, at maximum ASR, between ADSR. Vari-Response from linear to expo, faster towards expo.

behaviours.name: Voltage MATH
behaviours.rule: OUT 1 and OUT 2 both carry CH1 + attenuverted CH2. With CH2 unpatched the attenuverter sets a ±offset. Uses: mix two CVs, invert (e.g. Contour falling Overtone), scale (vibrato depth into 1V/OCT), and mult one source to two destinations.

behaviours.name: Clock and random
behaviours.rule: Clock tempo is tapped on PGM_B, taken from TEMPO input pulses, or follows MIDI clock when enabled; the sources combine. Each clock gives a new stepped random value. Patching EOC to TEMPO syncs random to the slope cycle.

behaviours.name: MIDI A
behaviours.rule: Receives on all channels by default. CV is always on the oscillator and adds to 1V/OCT, which can act as transpose. Gate normals to CONTOUR; legato keeps one gate until all notes are released, retrigger regates each note.

behaviours.name: MIDI B
behaviours.rule: A second converter with jacks: CV from note, velocity (default), mod wheel or a triangle LFO; gate from note on, velocity or mod wheel above 50 % (default), or a square LFO; the LFOs share a rate tapped on PGM_A. Separate channels make the 0-Coast a two-channel MIDI-to-CV interface.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: MIDI only. Traditional: held notes in played order at the clock rate. Latch & Shift: notes are added and kept after release, replaying a note removes it, up to 20 notes.

behaviours.name: Portamento
behaviours.rule: CC 65 switches analogue portamento, CC 5 sets its time in 64ths of the clock (50 % takes a full pulse); it follows clock and CC changes, so it can be automated.

behaviours.name: Program pages and CC
behaviours.rule: Hold PGM_A to enter seven pages (arp type, legato, MIDI learn, MIDI B CV source, MIDI B gate source, MIDI clock, calibrate). PGM_B steps values; hold PGM_A to reset a page; hold PGM_B to exit. CC 102-119 set these and more, but only while in the pages. PGM_A + PGM_B at power-on restores defaults.

behaviours.name: Calibration
behaviours.rule: Calibrate MIDI A to the VCO (pitch full CCW, fine 10:00, about 3 min) or MIDI B to an external VCO via the TEMPO input (about 6 min); warm up 20 minutes, no cables.

behaviours.name: Firmware
behaviours.rule: The November 2016 update added clock-synced portamento (CC 5, 65) and program-page editing by CC (Sonicstate). From 1.6.8, settings CCs are accepted only in the program pages (Coast Express); its release note lists a fix to MIDI B CV range for velocity and mod wheel (as quoted by Subsystem).

behaviours.name: Oscillator sync
behaviours.rule: Patching the square to SLOPE TRIG restarts the cycling Slope on every oscillator cycle; RISE, FALL and Vari-Response then shape a synced tone (Sound On Sound; the manual's Sync Bass patch).

behaviours.name: FM
behaviours.rule: LIN FM is AC-coupled and keeps pitch tracking; cycling SLOPE at audio rate is the obvious modulator. Above about 80 % the FM bus overdrives. For exponential FM patch into 1V/OCT, through Voltage MATH for depth.

source_inconsistencies: The CONTOUR AD description says gate length is ignored and only the rising edge counts (p.27), but sustain is held for as long as the gate is high (pp.27-28).
The Control Voltage Range page refers to 'the grey Frequency pot for VCO A' and a Voltage MATH attenuator on 1V/OCT while discussing MULTIPLY (p.21), apparently from another Make Noise manual.
MIDI B CV can be assigned to aftertouch according to p.17, but the program page offers only note, velocity, mod wheel and LFO (p.14).
The panel legend calls MIDI B's jacks 'Ext. CV Output' and 'Ext. Gate Output' (p.8); the text calls them MIDI B CV and Gate.
Contour and Slope are described as reaching +8 V, but the figures draw a +10 V axis (pp.27-28, 33).
The DYNMC output is 'more than 3 times' line level on p.29 and the triangle 'over 4 times hotter' on p.10, both about 10 Vpp.
MIDI A CV in LFO mode has its rate 'set by CLocK OUT' (CC 104), while MIDI B's LFO rate is tapped on PGM_A (p.15).
The contents list a '???' page (p.43) with no title.

Between sources: retailers say firmware 1.6.8 'adds Portamento and other MIDI features', but portamento arrived in the November 2016 update and the 1.6.8 note lists only a MIDI B range fix (Sonicstate, Subsystem).
Between sources: Make Noise gives 5.5 x 9 x 0.75 inches; a retailer gives 14 x 22.5 x 1.9 cm (5.5 x 8.9 x 0.75 in), consistent within rounding.

modelling_gaps.detail: OVERTONE and MULTIPLY are typed 'effects' with a kind property; a 'wavefolder' or 'waveshaper' module type (schema 0.14.0) would describe them better.
DYNAMICS is a 'vca' with lowpass_gate: true; its filtering is described, not modelled as a cutoff.
Unmarked knobs mapped 7:00 = 0 to 5:00 = 10, attenuverters -5 to +5; manual clock positions are converted on that basis.
Cable routes are drawn too small to transcribe reliably; a higher-resolution manual would allow full cords.
